headlines.title: 6월 생산 ·소비·투자 3개월 만에 ‘ 트리플 증가 ’…반도체·車 반등
headlines.summary: ■데이터처 6월 산업활동동향 경기도 평택항에 컨테이너가 쌓여있는 모습. 연합뉴스 반도체와 자동차 생산이 살아나면서 6월 생산과 소비, 투자가 3개월 만에 일제히 증가했다. 국가데이터처가 31일 발표한 ‘6월 산업활동동향’에 따르면 전산업생산지수는 전월보다 2.3% 상승했다. 지난 4월(-0.5%)과 5월(-0.4%) 두 달 연속 감소한 뒤 반등한 것이다.

headlines.title: 반도체· 자동차 쌍끌이 에… 생산 6년래 최대폭 증가

top5_headlines.summary: ■데이터처 6월 산업활동동향 경기도 평택항에 컨테이너가 쌓여있는 모습. 연합뉴스 반도체와 자동차 생산이 살아나면서 6월 생산과 소비, 투자가 3개월 만에 일제히 증가했다. 국가데이터처가 31일 발표한 ‘6월 산업활동동향’에 따르면 전산업생산지수는 전월보다 2.3% 상승했다. 지난 4월(-0.5%)과 5월(-0.4%) 두 달 연속 감소한 뒤 반등한 것이다.

key_headlines.title: Industrial Production Surges 6-Year High with Auto and Semiconductor Recovery
key_headlines.summary: June industrial production increased by 2.3%, marking the largest gain in 6 years, driven by automobile production (+15.4%) and semiconductor recovery (+4.5%). This represents a rare 'triple increase' with simultaneous growth in consumption and investment.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Records Historic 18% Single-Day Rally Amid Leverage ETF Unwinding
key_headlines.summary: The KOSPI index surged 1,000.89 points (+17.91%) on July 31st, marking its largest daily gain since inception in 1983. JP Morgan reported that leverage ETF deleveraging is substantially complete, reducing further sell-off pressures in Korean markets.

key_headlines.title: First-Half Tax Revenue Exceeds 220 Trillion Won on Stock Market and Real Estate Boom
key_headlines.summary: Tax revenue for the first half of 2026 surpassed 220 trillion won, with securities transaction tax surging 338% due to stock market prosperity and increased real estate transactions. August corporate tax prepayments are expected to significantly boost full-year tax collection.

key_headlines.title: Doosan Acquires SK Siltronic for Strategic AI Infrastructure Expansion
key_headlines.summary: Doosan acquired a 70.6% stake in SK Siltronic, completing its diversification into semiconductor materials alongside existing energy and robotics businesses. The acquisition positions Doosan as a major player in AI infrastructure development.

key_headlines.title: U.S. Big Tech Companies Invest Over 1 Trillion Dollars in AI Infrastructure
key_headlines.summary: Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta have collectively invested over 1 trillion dollars in AI since early 2023, with capital expenditures reaching 1.1 trillion dollars by mid-2026. Investment focus includes data centers, advanced AI semiconductors, and power infrastructure.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy showed strong recovery momentum in June with industrial production, consumption, and investment all rising simultaneously for the first time in three months. The 2.3% increase in overall industrial production marked a six-year high, primarily driven by robust automobile production recovery and semiconductor sector revival. Auto production surged 15.4% while semiconductors grew 4.5%, reflecting the resolution of supply chain disruptions. This 'triple increase' pattern indicates broadening economic recovery beyond just specific sectors, suggesting improved business and consumer sentiment despite previous volatility.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Japan maintained its policy rate at 1% while raising its growth forecasts for 2026 from 0.5% to 0.6% and for 2027 to 0.8%. This upgrade reflects global economic resilience driven by AI-related investment expansion and Japanese government stimulus measures. Meanwhile, the U.S. Federal Reserve maintained rates at 3.50-3.75%, but with three FOMC members dissenting in favor of a 0.25% increase, signaling ongoing inflation concerns despite recent economic data. South Korea's first-half tax revenue exceeded 220 trillion won, with expectations for further increases as corporate tax prepayments begin in August, reflecting strong semiconductor and export company performance.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI recorded its largest single-day rally in history on July 31st with an 18% surge to above 6,500 points, recovering from earlier lows near 5,500. Samsung Electronics posted its highest daily gain in 51 years (+26.81%), while SK Hynix hit its daily limit for the first time in 17 years (+29.95%). JP Morgan analysis indicates that leverage ETF deleveraging is substantially complete, reducing systemic sell-off risks. However, market observers caution that extreme volatility persists, describing current conditions as resembling a 'casino market' despite improved investor sentiment.
sections.Industry & Technology: Doosan Group completed a major strategic acquisition of SK Siltronic by purchasing a 70.6% stake, marking the company's largest deal in 19 years. This acquisition completes Doosan's AI infrastructure portfolio, adding semiconductor materials to its existing energy and robotics businesses. The semiconductor materials sector is critical for AI chip production, with SK Siltronic specializing in wafer testing and backend semiconductor processing. Hyundai Engineering announced a new value system emphasizing organic connection between space and energy, expanding into advanced industries including battery production, electric vehicle components, data centers, and shipbuilding.
sections.Real Estate: Series apartment developments offering sequential launches (phase 1, phase 2) are gaining market prominence as buyer demand becomes increasingly selective. The trend reflects investor preference for pre-verified locations and branded properties over generic developments. High-end branded apartment complexes are commanding premium pricing and stronger demand compared to standard apartment units, emphasizing the market preference for differentiated design and brand scarcity. However, apartment subscription account cancellations have surged to 300,000 this year alone, with the subscriber base falling below 26 million due to rising sale prices, lending restrictions, and attractive stock market returns diverting investment interest.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. and Japan conducted coordinated intervention in currency markets to support the yen against the dollar, with the yen strengthening approximately 3% following substantial Japanese purchases. The U.S. Federal Reserve maintained its hawkish stance despite holding rates steady, with multiple officials suggesting potential future rate increases, creating uncertainty in global financial markets. The Bank of Japan signaled potential acceleration in future rate hikes as domestic economic conditions improve. Rising international tensions around AI competition, particularly regarding semiconductor export controls to China, continue to affect global investment sentiment and currency dynamics.
sections.AI & Economy: U.S. Big Tech companies—Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta—have collectively invested over 1 trillion dollars in AI infrastructure since early 2023, with capital expenditures totaling 1.1 trillion dollars through June 2026. These investments focus on data centers, advanced AI semiconductors, and power infrastructure to support generative AI competition. Unlike past internet platform era profits achieved without major manufacturing, AI competition now requires massive direct infrastructure investments resembling traditional heavy industries. China's AI investments, while significantly smaller in private sector terms, are being substantially augmented through government-directed funding to narrow the technology gap with the U.S. Five new AI-focused ETFs related to data center investments are launching in early August.
sections.Others: Single-stock leverage ETFs with increased minimum deposits saw trading volume drop to one-quarter of previous levels despite stock prices surging 48-60% on the first trading day. The regulatory change raising minimum deposits from 10 million won to 30 million won was implemented to reduce market volatility. The U.S. administration is considering charging international students 140,000 dollars in employment fees as part of tightened immigration policies. A Swiss startup raised 2.6 billion won for AI server rental services, reflecting new business models where companies lease AI computing power rather than purchase expensive equipment outright, similar to aircraft leasing practices.
